subject: Align Q3 pilot demo windows and procurement milestones
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@omnihealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 pilot demo & procurement timeline — proposed windows

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We heard you on the timeline and the need to get procurement and security aligned before the end of July. To keep things moving I wanted to propose two windows for a combined demo + procurement sync next week:

- Option A: Tue Jul 6, 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min — technical deep dive + 30-min procurement breakout)
- Option B: Thu Jul 8, 13:00–14:30 PT (90 min)

Marcus (SE) will run the technical section; I (AE) will cover commercial/next steps. Laura, copying for calendar coordination and deal ownership.

Action items: could you confirm which window works for the engineering + procurement stakeholders? Also, could you share a quick usage forecast (20–30 min summary) so Marcus can tailor the dedicated capacity sizing discussion?

Attachments: none on this email — we can attach the dedicated sizing template once times are confirmed.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@omnihealth.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@omnihealth.com>, Claire Dobson <claire.dobson@omnihealth.com>, procurement@omnihealth.com, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 pilot demo & procurement timeline — proposed windows

Hi Ben —

Thanks — appreciate the options. Quick notes from our side:

- Engineering (Samir) is out Mon–Wed next week for a conference, so Tue morning won't work.
- Procurement (Claire & team) prefers shorter meetings during lunch or late afternoons.
- Security wants to see SOC 2 and a short summary of data handling in advance.

Given that, can we aim for Thu Jul 8, 13:00 PT if you can shorten the procurement breakout to 20–30 minutes? If not, Fri Jul 9 afternoon works for procurement.

I'll attach the procurement intake template and looped the procurement alias. Also attaching our rough usage forecast (internal) so you have a baseline — this is high-level but should help with sizing.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Sr. Director, Platform Engineering | OmniHealth
pri ya.shah@omnihealth.com | +1 212-555-0244

Attachment: omni_internal_usage_summary.csv

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 pilot demo & procurement timeline — technical agenda + sizing needs

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads up. Proposed technical agenda for the 90-minute session (we can compress as requested):

1) 10 min — Introductions & pilot objectives (ben/laura)
2) 30 min — Live demo (end-to-end latency/cost focus)
3) 25 min — Dedicated sizing walkthrough (Marcus) — I'll use the usage numbers you shared to show throughput and tail latency tradeoffs
4) 15 min — Security/compliance Q&A (high level: deployment modes, data isolation, KMS)
5) 10 min — Procurement next steps + decision checkpoints

If you need the procurement chunk shortened to 20 min, I can tweak the demo to 25 min and sizing to 20 min. Please confirm which you prefer.

Attachments: dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (I will upload the final sizing worksheet once you confirm a slot).

Regards,
Marcus Lin | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@omnihealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@omnihealth.com>, Claire Dobson <claire.dobson@omnihealth.com>, procurement@omnihealth.com
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 pilot demo & procurement timeline — proposed windows

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick replies. To keep this moving and respect calendar constraints, proposing a short scheduling poll with three concrete options and asking procurement to mark availability:

- Option 1: Thu Jul 8, 13:00–14:00 PT (compressed 60 min; 25-min demo / 20-min sizing / 15-min procurement/security)
- Option 2: Fri Jul 9, 15:00–16:30 PT (90 min)
- Option 3: Mon Jul 12, 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min)

Priya — based on your shared forecast, I attached a template that Marcus can use to run a tight sizing exercise in the meeting (see attached "omni_q3_usage_forecast.xlsx"). Marcus/Rishi, can you confirm you'll be able to run the 25-min compressed sizing if Option 1 is selected?

Procurement & Security: if you can review the one-pager (redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf) ahead of time that will speed decisio n-making in the meeting. I've also added a short privacy/security slide deck to the drive link.

Let me know if we should include anyone from our Product/Legal teams — otherwise I'll send a calendar invite once everyone thumbs up one of the poll options.

Best,
Laura Bennett | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133

Attachments: omni_q3_usage_forecast.xlsx, redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf
